comments.text: Secrets are restored by slice index instead of by provider name. Since adding/removing/reordering providers shifts indexes, this assigns stored secrets to the wrong providers. Example: stored [google(secretG)], submitted [apple(no secret), google(no secret)] -> apple receives google's secret and google gets none (validation fails or, worse, apple is saved with another provider's credential). Likewise removing the first provider moves its secret onto the next one. This is a correctness and credential-mixing bug; match on `Name` (as the stored providers are keyed by name) instead.

Only clientSecret is preserved; any other field omitted from a partial provider payload is still zeroed. Also an explicit `"clientSecret": ""` can no longer be distinguished from an omitted one, so a secret can't be cleared. Consider merging the submitted raw object onto the stored provider with the same name so that only submitted keys override.
No tests added. Please cover adding a provider before an existing one, removing a provider, and reordering, verifying each keeps its own secret.
